name: Quiz Show
description: A multi-round quiz you write yourself: students race to answer each question on their devices, faster correct answers earn more points, and a leaderboard crowns the round. Write as many questions as you like — the game builds one round per question.
tagline: Perfect for test review, vocabulary checks, or a Friday brain-teaser block.

questions.label: Questions
questions.helper: One round per question. Mark the right answer — it must match one of the choices exactly.

question.placeholder: What is the capital of Australia?

default.question: What is the capital of Australia?

speedBonus.label: Speed bonus
speedBonus.helper: Faster correct answers earn more points (Kahoot-style). Off = every correct answer is worth the same.

template.name: Quiz Show
template.description: Race to answer — fastest correct answers earn the most points.
